title: Finn
subtitle: The Resistance
description: FN-2187 experienced an awakening on the desert planet of Jakku in addition to a crisis of conscience. Refusing to kill innocent villagers, he fled the control of the First Order and broke Resistance Pilot Poe Dameron out of captivity to escape. Poe gave him the name Finn and helped set him on the beginning of his journey to join the Resistance and discover his abilities in the Force.
